Palette: wet blue-grey fog and pine green against the amber of a kerosene lamp, candles and a bare kitchen bulb; teak-brown interiors, warm light losing to cold. An empty rattan chair and a low table on a wet villa terrace, no people. An opened handwritten letter lies on the table under a drinking glass, its envelope beside it. Fog presses against the wooden balustrade and the pine trunks behind dissolve into white. Mood: quiet, foreboding.
